file_insights.purpose: Verification script to validate HTML tooltip implementation and required fields in gantt.rs
key_operations: grep -A 8 for tooltip generation code extraction
Field validation loop checking for 6 required fields (id, stage, provider, duration, tokens, cost)
Exit code signaling (0 for success, 1 for failure)

patterns_discovered.description: Created standalone bash script to validate implementation details rather than modifying source code
patterns_discovered.benefit: Non-invasive verification that can be reused and shared

patterns_discovered.description: Uses grep with exact string matching to verify presence of required field names in source
Script follows Unix convention of returning 0 for success, non-zero for failure
patterns_discovered.benefit: Compatible with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing

gotchas_discovered.description: Field detection uses exact quoted strings (e.g., '"id:"'). Will miss variations like 'id :' (with space) or single quotes
gotchas_discovered.impact: False negatives if field formatting varies

gotchas_discovered.description: Script only validates that fields exist in code, not that they're properly formatted, populated, or rendered in actual tooltips
gotchas_discovered.impact: Could pass validation while tooltips are malformed or incomplete

gotchas_discovered.description: grep -A 8 may truncate tooltip generation code if it exceeds 8 lines

approach_outcome.description: Successfully created a verification script that checks HTML tooltip implementation against required fields

recommendations.recommendation: Enhance field detection with regex patterns
recommendations.rationale: Current exact string matching is brittle; regex would handle whitespace variations and different quote styles
recommendations.example: Use grep -E '"(id|stage|provider|duration|tokens|cost):' instead of exact string matching

recommendations.recommendation: Add structural validation beyond presence checks
recommendations.rationale: Verify not just that fields exist but that they're properly integrated into tooltip generation logic
recommendations.example: Check that fields are included in the format! macro that generates the tooltip string

recommendations.recommendation: Add dynamic line counting for grep output
recommendations.rationale: Replace hardcoded -A 8 with dynamic limit based on actual code structure
recommendations.example: Use grep -A 100 or search for the closing brace to ensure complete capture

recommendations.recommendation: Create integration test for tooltip rendering
recommendations.rationale: Complement this bash verification with actual runtime tests of rendered tooltips
recommendations.example: Add unit tests that verify tooltip content contains all required fields with correct values
